description:
[Calculators] Build an Industrial Conveyor filter to paste into the game. The conveyor page's filter builder (https://rust.wiki/calculators/conveyor). `filter_json` is exactly what the
in-game conveyor copies and pastes (a list of {TargetCategory, TargetItemName, MaxAmountInOutput, BufferAmount,
MinAmountInInput, IsBlueprint}); paste it on the conveyor's filter screen. A conveyor holds 30 filters; `unknown`
lists names that matched nothing.

categories.description: Comma-separated whole categories: weapon, construction, general, resource, attire, tool, medical, food, ammo, trap, misc, component, electrical, fun.

max_out.description: MaxAmountInOutput for every filter (0 = no limit).

starter.description: Start from a ready-made list: Furnace feed, Smelted output, Tool Cupboard upkeep, Raid box, Boom crafting, Meds, Fuel, Recycler run.

name: build_conveyor_filter
title: Build an Industrial Conveyor filter to paste into the game
